## Goal
- Produce a truthful, evidence-based end-to-end deployment verification for `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`, including canonical GitHub, CI, Render, and live SHA parity.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use only canonical repository `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`.
- Never expose credentials, OTPs, passwords, bearer tokens, service-role keys, or personal identities.
- Do not paste tokens into chat; use private secret mechanisms only.
- Preserve local code; do not reset, overwrite, or delete approved work without explicit authorization.
- Do not deploy until OTP plaintext persistence is eliminated and focused OTP tests pass.
- Do not certify production without independently matching `GitHub HEAD = Actions source SHA = Render deployed SHA = live /version SHA`.
- User wants immediate execution and proof, not repeated credential narratives.
- Continue all QA that does not require unavailable canonical-provider credentials.

  bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts backend/ivx-autonomous-coder.test.ts

## Key Decisions
- Treat live `/health`, `/version`, and `/readiness` results as verified runtime health at `012bb088...`, not GitHub, CI, or Render provenance.
- Do not claim end-to-end deployment verification until all four SHA sources independently match.
- Treat production `401` results as guard-enforcement proof only; they do not validate protected success paths.
- Do not certify AI primary operation while `/api/public/chat` reports:
  ```text
  source="fallback"
  ```
- Do not rely on prior local test-pass claims until tests are rerun after `bun install --frozen-lockfile`.
- Keep any future GitHub/Render verification read-only and minimum scope; never log credential values.
